title: ToggleGroup
lead: A collection of toggle buttons capable of being switched between two states: on or off.

examples.name: ToggleGroup
examples.code:
<ToggleGroup
  a11yTitle="Choose option"
  options={[
    {icon: <Icons.Bold />, value: 'bold'},
    {icon: <Icons.Italic />, value: 'italic'},
    {icon: <Icons.Underline />, value: 'underline'}
  ]}
/>
